subject: health
unitTitle: Safety, Injury Prevention, and Digital Life
essentialQuestion: How do I prevent harm and respond well when something goes wrong?

prompts.prompt: Explain injury prevention and protective gear in your own words and give or identify a valid example.

Use a diagram of a general figure or character rather than your own body, a picture sequence, a model, a described demonstration, or a checked source, to show what you learned about emergency response and calling for help.
Apply what you learned about medicines, household chemicals, and substance safety to a new fictional situation. Show the steps or name the source you relied on.
A made-up character makes an unsafe or unreliable choice involving basic first aid and when to get an adult. Explain what is wrong, correct it, and say why the correction is safer.
Connect injury prevention and protective gear with recognising unsafe requests and refusing. Explain how the two ideas support or depend on one another.
Present the strongest evidence from the unit task: Create a safety and refusal plan covering an activity, an online situation, and an emergency, reviewed and confirmed by a guardian.
Name one skill you can now use somewhere else, one way to check your own work, and one question you still have. This is about the skill, not about your private life; nothing private has to be shared.
